criteria.criterion: Apply GitHub PR filters (open, non-draft) and sort by most recently updated
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: screenshots verify the agent applied the required open/non-draft filter and updated-desc sorting via the GitHub query in the URL.

criteria.criterion: Inspect the first three results after filtering/sorting
criteria.final_justification: Downscore: the agent did not inspect the actual first three results after filtering/sorting; they inspected the 1st, 2nd, and 4th visible results. This is a controllable selection error, not a blocker.

Partial credit: most required fields for PR #7506 are evidenced and can be reported accurately from GitHub UI. However, the agent’s predicted output includes an unsupported/incorrect last-updated date (claims Jun 26, 2026 vs latest visible Jun 25, 2026) and asserts file path/test-file absence without the filenames being evidenced in screenshots. Missing/incorrect verification prevents full credit.

Low credit: the agent did visit #7586 and Files changed is evidenced enough to confirm changed-file count (2) and test-file presence (yes), but the rest of the required fields (title, author, last-updated, labels, additions, deletions) are not verified in screenshots, and the agent’s output title for #7586 contradicts the action history link text. Award minimal points for the parts that are directly evidenced.

Some credit for inspection but not full: the agent’s predicted output for the third PR contains major factual errors (wrong title/author/labels and even different changes) compared to screenshots. Because the output does not correctly report GitHub-displayed info for #7543, this criterion cannot receive more than minimal credit for having opened the PR.

criteria.criterion: Verify presence of test files in 'Files changed' for each PR
criteria.final_justification: Partial: test-file presence is correctly verifiable for #7586 (Yes) and #7543 (No), but not verifiable for #7506 from the provided Files changed filename list. The agent nonetheless asserted ‘No’ for #7506, which is unsupported by the screenshot evidence.

criteria.criterion: Rank the three PRs by changed-file count
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: ranking by changed-file count is supported by the screenshots (7586 has 2 files; 7506 and 7543 have 1 each). Even though the agent’s selection of ‘first three PRs’ was off, this criterion evaluates ranking among the three they reported, and the file counts support the ordering.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in and no PR modifications
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: evidence supports that the agent did not sign in and did not perform any prohibited PR modifications.
